caption_L1: Here a bar graph is named Leading coffee exporting countries worldwide in 2018 (in million U.S. dollars). The x-axis measures Trade value in million U.S. dollars on linear scale of range 0 to 4,000 while the y-axis plots Country on categorical scale from Belgium to United States.
caption_L2L3: Brazil is clearly the leading coffee exporter in 2018 with a value of almost 5000 million. Columbia, Germany & Switzerland are all around the 2500 million mark. France is the only other country above 1000 million with the rest all being below this.
